_weekday_ramp: 3-round recipe (28 Jul 2026): every day is one easy + one medium + one hard per rounds game, and 'the week gets harder' happens INSIDE each tier — Monday's slots prefer the most famous end of their tier, Sunday's the least, linearly across the week. This weight is the ranking-nudge size for a full-spectrum miss; 0 turns the ramp off.
_tone: TONE / COMPOSITION CAPS (25 Jul 2026). Sanctioned by the launch review (tools/out/launch-review-2026-08-03/weekly-and-window-assessment.md): 'cap all-power-figure human slates' and 'prevent any one dark theme from swallowing an edition'. These are about TONE, not difficulty: how hard a round is and how heavy it feels are separate concerns and get separate controls. Applied by `propose` to NEWLY GENERATED editions only — freeze, approve and verify never evaluate them, so the settled manifest is untouched.
_dark_tone_ids: Curated tags, by game. The test is SUBJECT MATTER, not moral judgement of the person and not demographics: tag a subject when the reason we are interested in them is authoritarian rule, mass atrocity, political terror or organised crime — or, for objects and boards, execution, mass death and destruction. Deliberately NARROW: dying violently does not qualify (JFK, MLK, Franz Ferdinand are not tagged), and neither does simply having fought a war. Holocaust-adjacent figures are tagged on both sides of it, because an issue carrying Hitler, Eichmann and Elie Wiesel is three-quarters one dark theme however the moral ledger reads. Edit this list freely — it is the intended place to disagree.
